```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import json
import os
from datetime import datetime
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# Database connection [cite: 8, 106]
DB_FILE = os.path.join("3_outputs", "financial_summaries.json")
RENDER_TIME = datetime.now()

display(Markdown(f"Dashboard Rendered: **{RENDER_TIME.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}**"))
display(Markdown("\n\n<br>\n\n"))

def get_analyst_data(target_name):
    if not os.path.exists(DB_FILE):
        return []
    with open(DB_FILE, "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    
    # Filter for analyst and sort by processed_at descending [cite: 120, 131, 139]
    filtered = [v for v in data if v['channel_name'] == target_name]
    filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('processed_at', ''), reverse=True)
    return filtered

def calculate_age(processed_at_str):
    try:
        proc_date = datetime.strptime(processed_at_str, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        delta = RENDER_TIME - proc_date
        return delta.days
    except:
        return "Unknown"

def render_analyst(name):
    videos = get_analyst_data(name)
    display(Markdown(f"# {name}"))
    
    if not videos:
        display(Markdown(f"No data available for {name}, Rayne."))
        return

    for video in videos:
        proc_dt = video.get('processed_at', 'Unknown')
        age = calculate_age(proc_dt)
        
        display(Markdown(f"\n---\n"))
        # H2 heading for TOC indexing [cite: 144, 154, 162]
        display(Markdown(f"## {video['title']}"))
        
        display(Markdown(f"""
<div class='video-meta'>
<b>Source Date:</b> {video.get('date_of_interest', 'N/A')} | 
<b>Processed:</b> {proc_dt} | 
<b>Age:</b> {age} days ago
</div>
"""))
        
        display(Markdown(video['analysis']))
        display(Markdown("\n\n"))

# Sequential rendering to maintain TOC hierarchy
render_analyst("Benjamin Cowen")
render_analyst("Tom Hayes")
render_analyst("Forward Guidance")
```
